title: Strategic Client Request Windowing and Release Quota Protocol
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a structured protocol to convert strategic client asks into time-boxed request windows and a release quota system that preserves sprint capacity while offering predictable commitment signals to top-tier customers.
problem_statement: Top strategic accounts frequently request feature accelerations or scope changes mid-cycle. Engineering and PM teams currently accommodate many of these ad-hoc asks, which disrupts sprint predictability and causes knock-on regressions in SLAs for other customers. Existing intake lacks a bounded commitment model that maps request priority to a finite release quota and windowed decision cadence.
proposed_solution: Introduce a three-part protocol: 1) Signal Windowing — weekly intake windows for strategic requests with a hard cutoff; 2) Release Quota — allocate a per-quarter quota of sprint slots convertible to "feature tokens" that customers can redeem; 3) Commitment Buffer — hold a small reserve of engineering capacity for urgent escalations with defined eligibility and decommit rules. The protocol includes tooling in the console to visualize a customer's quota balance and an internal triage board to reconcile request signals with OKRs.
metrics: % reduction in mid-cycle scope churn (target: 40% by EOY)
# sprint slots preserved for planned roadmap (target: +25% per quarter)
customer satisfaction (NPS) for strategic request handling (target: +5 pts)
acceptance_criteria: Console shows customer quota and last 3 redeemed tokens in UI mock
Triage board enforces intake window cutoffs and auto-queues requests for next window
SLA for escalation decisions documented and met in pilot with 3 accounts
Metrics pipeline emitting churn and slot preservation signals to dashboard
